Australian MPs seek control over online feeds from 'nudification' apps

Australian female Members of Parliament are seeking to regain control over their online social media feeds, which are being targeted by 'nudification' applications. These apps reportedly alter images to create explicit content. The issue highlights concerns about online harassment and the impact of Big Tech on the digital environment for public figures. Efforts are underway to address these challenges and protect individuals from such digital manipulation.
